"body": "**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Use a repo-relative path for the GUI driver**

When this checklist is followed from `out/` as the previous step requires, `scripts/gui-drive.sh` resolves to `out/scripts/gui-drive.sh`, not the script at the repository root; the later `rect` example repeats this path. Use `../scripts/gui-drive.sh` or an absolute path. The app itself must remain launched from `out/` to find its data.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L53-L53](https://github.com/matemolnar8/vitadeck/blob/f0d05d344a698b00618fe76f06d9e72e66b01637/AGENTS.md#L53-L53)
